svg.title: Planetary Assault Barge - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Small Craft Catalogue (2023), printed 67-68, PDF 68-69. Combined envelope uses larger Deck 2 outline; smaller Deck 1 is contained beneath it. Retains long capsule body and shallow forward bridge shoulder from the deckplan. The illustration appears spherical while the deckplan is elongated; this silhouette follows the combined deckplan envelope despite that discrepancy. Detached turret symbols and vertical antennae excluded; no room borders traced.
